messages.text: gwinnett county commission packet for thursday is 180 pages lol. you seeing the buford hwy corridor rezoning?
yeah i pulled it at lunch. they're finally talking sidewalks on the stretch by indian creek. about time.
MARTA expansion mention is buried on page 94 btw
found it. if they actually fund the gwinnett connector i can ditch the 285 commute. fingers crossed.
Are you closing the laptop soon? You sounded tight in your voice earlier, and I know this is one of those long finance weeks.
Trying to send two more things before 9. My shoulders are practically at my ears, so I am setting the phone across the room after that.
Good. Eat something warm, take the heating pad upstairs, and do not start answering every new message in bed.
That is the plan. If the controller thread turns into a real tonight item, I will check once, but otherwise I am done.
Saw flashing lights on Ponce when I drove past your turn this morning, you good?
Ha yeah that was me. Rolling stop at the Clifton sign apparently. Got a warning, no ticket.
Oof. He nice about it?
Polite enough. Was out of there in like six minutes. Already at my desk.
That ramen counter in Kyoto you sent has only 9 seats. Are you saving it for the blossom week list?
Yes, it went into my Kyoto folder with the tiny matcha place and the canal walk post.
Send me the handle later. Also the dumpling account posted a pop-up in Summerhill on the 15th.
Saved that too. Their tagged map makes it look close enough for a weeknight.
How's the FAR section going? You still on track for the May 16 sitting?
Saw a post in the UGA Terry alumni feed about a regional CFO panel in Buckhead next month. Worth a look?
Slow. Becker review questions are brutal after a full day of close. I keep telling myself this is the bridge to the Director seat in two years.
Send the link. Anyone from our cohort speaking?
You said that exact line back when you were grinding the M&A diligence rotation. Worked then.
Anita from our finance elective is moderating. I already messaged her there to grab a coffee before.
Perfect. I'll RSVP tonight and add her on the same thread.
Different bridge, same playbook. Level I CFA registration window opens in May too, I want both on the wall by year end.
You going by Mom and Dad's Sunday? I can bring the folding chair if we end up watching first pitch there.
Yes, after lunch. Also need Dad to show me the new cuff log before I forget.
Good. He listens better when you ask. Mom said the front steps are still annoying her, so maybe no backyard setup.
Living room it is. Text Maya to bring whatever dip she was talking about.
Do you want me to bring the folding chairs Sunday, or do you still have yours in the garage?
Mine are still here. I am setting up the table Saturday night so I can just cook after church.
Good. Please leave yourself a calm hour after everyone heads out.
That is the plan. Dishwasher, chairs back in the garage, then no talking until Monday coffee.
For Sunday lunch, should I pack two containers of arroz con pollo or just one for your fridge?
One is plenty. My freezer is still full of single portions from last weekend.
Good. And no need to bring anyone unless you want to. Your father only asked because he likes setting too many places.
Tell him one plate for me. I may bring peach crumble, though.
Pastor Wallace asked if we'd see you Easter weekend. I told him you'd come up for the 10:30 with us.
Yeah I can do that. Driving up Saturday night, same as last year.
Good. He's doing the lily blessing again. Bring deviled eggs?
Done. I'll grab the rolls too.
Still good for the easy BeltLine loop Saturday? I can keep it walk-jog pace if your ankle is talking.
Yes. It felt fine on stairs this morning. I packed the stretchy band and two Advil just in case, but I want to keep moving.
Perfect. Bring water, and let's do coffee after instead of trying to be heroes.
Deal. Coffee after, and I am sticking with one glass at Priya's dinner Friday so I am not sluggish.
Saturday after the loop, are you still up for the 9:15 mat class?
Yes, keeping it gentle. I may walk there and leave my phone at home for that hour.
Good. Bring the ankle wrap, and skip the hill by the park.
Deal. I also moved my Dr. Kim video slot so I am not rushing straight from work.
I found a March 28 morning bib thing by Piedmont Park. Same group as last spring, donations go through the team page.
Send it. I can probably do 3.1 if we keep the first mile easy.
Deal. Do your band work twice this week and no heroic downhill plans before then!
Fair. The Kennesaw rocks still live rent-free in my calendar.
Hey, did you see the Lilburn Neighbors post about the water main work on Killian Hill? Your mom asked Daniel about it but I think you're closer to that block.
Yeah, popped up on my feed this morning. The HOA page also shared the city notice, so I forwarded it to Mom. They're saying tomorrow 9-2.
You're basically the family's neighborhood reporter at this point lol.
It's literally the only reason I still scroll that app. Family event invites and the neighborhood pages, that's it.
Did you see that piece on the Patagonia annual impact report? They actually publish the numbers, not just glossy photos.
Yes, that's the only kind I bother reading. If there's no scope 1, 2, 3 breakdown and a third-party assurance line, it's a marketing brochure.
Ha. You always go straight to the assurance footer.
It's the only page that tells you whether they actually had to defend a number. Anything else is just a vibe.
AJC just dropped a long piece on the use-of-force dashboard the county finally put online. Numbers are worse than they said last year.
Saw it. Forwarded it to Maya already. The fact that we had to wait two years for a usable spreadsheet is half the story.
Right? And the independent review board still has no subpoena power. That's the part nobody at the county meeting wants to touch.
Send me the link when you find it. I want to read it before the panel at work next week.
Tia Rosa called and asked if you can come Saturday for her birthday. I told her you'd try.
I want to but I'm stuck in budget close. Can you send her my love? I'll call her Sunday.
She'll like that. Just remember she'll switch into Spanish halfway through, she always does.
I know, I'll keep up. Mostly. Dad says she talks twice as fast as he does anyway.
Found a box of your old yearbooks in the Lilburn attic today. Parkview era. You had bangs, sweetheart.
Please tell me you did not photograph them. Daniel will never let me live it down.
Daniel already asked if I found his Little League trophies too. He says the bunk bed room still smells the same.
The four of us crammed into that house. I forget how small it actually was until I drive past.
Stopped at H Mart on Pleasant Hill on the way home, got the gochugaru you said was better than the Kroger one
Yes that's the one! If you're already over there, Hong Kong Supermarket two doors down has the Thai basil and good fish sauce
Lol how do you still know every aisle of that plaza
Mom used to drag me and Daniel through there every Saturday before soccer. Muscle memory at this point
Friday still works? I can bring the yogurt and that cumin-rice thing from the old case-team dinner.
Yes. I already started the dough and I have the curry leaves this time.
Perfect. Same rhythm as last time then: food first, then we can solve life after.
Deal. I also saved one portion for Marcus if the office leftovers plan falls through.
For Sunday, do you want that ginger-sesame rice bowl link again or are you doing soup?
Rice bowl this time. I am stopping at H Mart after work for the sesame oil and a bigger bag of rice.
Nice. If your basil is still going wild, add a few leaves at the end. It was so good last time.
It is. The pepper seedlings are crowding the tray too, so I need to repot before I start cooking.
Do you still need me to ask Ms. Harper whether the Norcross room has a projector for next Saturday?
Yes, please. I can bring printed credit-score scenarios, but slides would make the worksheet easier.
I found the extra file tabs you asked about. Do you still keep the 2021 closing packet in the hall cabinet?
Yes, top shelf in the blue folder. I need the settlement page before I call the escrow line Monday.
I will ask. Also please eat before your Tuesday speaking night this time, not just coffee.
Fair. I have the 6:45 slot and then I will come home and finish the Norcross copies.
Bring the utility notice too, just in case. Eat breakfast before you start sorting papers, please.
I will. I am matching the escrow estimate with the HOA increase and then doing groceries before lunch.
Want to meet at the Camp Creek lot at 9:00? Nothing steep if your ankle is still touchy.
That works. I did two easy loops at Lilburn City Park this week, so I should be fine if we keep the pace reasonable.
Perfect. Bring the poles just in case, and coffee after if we finish before lunch.
Deal. I have my shoes by the door already.
Sending you that coconut dal link before I forget. Do you still have the big pot I borrowed last fall?
Yes, back on the lower shelf with the Dutch oven and the pasta roller. I am making room by moving half the cookbooks off the counter.
Your kitchen shelves are more organized than my whole apartment. Also, did the basil survive this cold snap?
Barely. The little starts are inside by the puzzle table, which is currently all edge pieces and one very judgmental fern.
Saw a Jasper trail video and immediately thought of you. Those lakes look fake.
I saved it to the green folder. The fare tracker can keep tempting me, but the dining table wins this quarter.
Adult furniture beating mountain lakes is tragic but understandable.
I am calling it discipline, not tragedy.
I'm not driving back to East Atlanta at this hour lol. Couch?
Already pulling the spare blanket out. Spare key under the planter if you beat me home.
Bless. My ears are still ringing. Encore was unreal.
Coffee at 9, no earlier. I refuse to be conscious before that.
Did you sign up for the Kennesaw Spring 5K yet? Reg jumps from $45 to $60 Tuesday at midnight.
Just did. Bumped the donation tier up to $100 since I missed the corporate match window last quarter. Ankle felt fine on Saturday so I'm in.
Generous! That'll buy a kid like four weeks of summer lunches at the rec center. See you for the easy 4 Saturday.
7 AM at the Beltline trailhead works. Coffee after on me.
ok bad news, the HVAC tech said the capacitor finally gave. $387 with the service call. so close to that magic 400 number lol
ugh sorry. mine was like $410 last summer. did you have to scramble or were you fine?
fine, just annoying. you handled yours pretty calmly if i remember
i just put it on the Amex for points and pulled from the maintenance bucket the next morning. zero drama
Coffee after the farmers market? I can do 11:30 if your Sunday spreadsheet ritual is done.
Almost. I am matching the clinic portal totals to the pretax card and the monthly set-aside before I leave.
Coffee after the farmers market Saturday? I can do 11:30 if that leaves your morning errands alone.
11:30 works. I have the clinic portal forms first, then I want to be in bed early Friday so I don't drag through it.
Very you. Also remind me what your company gives for classes? Daniel is comparing whether his certification fee would be covered.
Mine has a yearly cap and manager approval. I used part of it for the Becker materials, so I want the receipt filed cleanly.
Very Judith. Forms, sleep, then coffee. Send me the place and I'll meet you there.
Dancing Goats in Decatur. Also saving the Emory chart note so I can ask one clean question instead of internet spiraling.
Cooking meetup at my place on the 21st, want me to put you down? Splitting groceries ~$28 each.
Yes please. Pulling from my discretionary envelope, I've still got room for March.
Ha, you and your envelopes. February ran hot?
About 300 over the normal 6,200-6,500. Trimmed dining out this week to claw it back, the auto-transfers go through on the 3rd regardless.
Maya said three cars on Pinecrest got hit last night. Glove boxes dumped on the seats.
Saw the Nextdoor thread. Mine's locked, nothing on the seats anymore. Been doing the walk-around every night since the last round.
Good. Even the charger cable? They grabbed one off Maya's dash last fall.
Cable in the console, sunglasses in the bag, bag inside. Learned my lesson the hard way in October.
How was today, mija? You looked tired Sunday.
Long. We are deep in the Q1 reforecast and I had Hadley in my office until almost 7 going through her variance commentary.
She is the new one? You have had her since the fall I think.
Yes. She is getting there. Five years in and I still remember being that nervous walking numbers up to the CFO.
Still on for Wed dinner or is the close eating you alive again?
Wed should hold. Thursday I'm out though, Renu wants me on the pilot retraining session after the model output drifted last cycle.
Drifted how, like the forecasting one or the GL classifier?
Classifier. Half the variance commentary in the deck came out wrong before I caught it. Adding a check tab in the workbook so I'm not staring at the same PPT at 11pm again.
Senate cmtee killed the voucher amendment today. Small win.
Saw it. Real win for the teachers who showed up to testify. My Fair Fight auto-renew hit yesterday too, $35 — felt earned this month.
you still going to the school board forum thursday? I can ride with you
Yeah. Out of the office by 6:15 if budget close behaves. Bring those questions you flagged about the media center cuts and the rezoning map.
Mom is already on me about Easter. You coming up?
Sat night through Sunday. Same as Christmas.
Lol twice a year all star.
Hey I show up when it counts. Mom would notice if either of us skipped.
Saw the runoff dates dropped for the council seat. You doing your usual first-week-of-early thing?
Braves tickets for the 21st: I can grab three if Maya comes, or two if it is just us.
Yeah. I went Thursday at 7am for the primary, same plan for the runoff. Lawrenceville site, in and out.
Do two for now. My Saturday is clean after study block, no extra logistics on my end.
Every cycle, presidential, midterm, school board, you name it. You should get a punch card.
Honestly the runoffs are where nobody shows up. Mom's the same way, she texted me the candidate forum link from the Lilburn page last night.
Clean Saturday sounds fake but useful. Also, did coffee guy survive the spreadsheet questions?
He was nice. Probably just a pleasant hour, not a whole new subplot.
Braves tickets for the 20th are cheap. Are you alive after spreadsheet mountain or still buried?
Alive, barely. I am already at 41 hours and tomorrow is packed, so this week is heading past my normal range.
Then pick a section and do not answer work at the game. Revolutionary idea.
Braves presale opened. You alive after the variance call?
Alive. Ten minutes with the cutting board and the carrots are now tiny cubes. Soup is doing its thing.
If we go, I am muting the thread after 9 unless the packet blows up. Also bringing ibuprofen because my neck is doing that thing.
That sounds like the most Judith response possible. Friday game or Sunday day game?
Sunday. Friday I want the couch, the crossword, and not to move the half-built puzzle from the coffee table.
Are we doing Yellow River Saturday or is that too far with your study block?
Too far this time. I can do the Greenway side near Lilburn after my morning chapter.
Fine by me. You already squeezed in the studio and a short run this week, so no need to turn Saturday into a death march.
Exactly. One steady hour, then I am going home for flashcards.
Mija, the HOA letter you forwarded - did the new dues already come out of your account?
Yeah, $312 hit Monday. I moved it from the HOA bucket so nothing else got squeezed.
Good. And the water heater quote you mentioned? Is that something you can cover this month or wait?
$1,480 installed. I'll put half on this Friday's check and half on the 20th. No one else's bills to juggle, just mine.
Did you see that Westside studio story? Saturday 9:15 has the ankle-friendly flow.
I bookmarked it last night. Same scroll sent me a coffee cart two blocks away.
Perfect. Class, coffee, then no heroic running.
Deal. I also saved the blossom stairway clip you tagged me in, but that is for the big someday folder.
Daniel says you want carrot cake for Saturday? 🎂
if it's not too much trouble! Mom is already doing the German chocolate 😅
Two cakes for 34 is correct math. Also Daniel pulled out your dad's old Little League photos from Gainesville last night - the haircuts are devastating 😂
oh god, hide those before Saturday please
I found a dumpling class for April. Can your work learning bucket handle one more receipt this quarter?
Probably not for dumplings, sadly. It covered the CPA review invoice because it ties to my role.
Fair. Did HR ever fix the retirement-match notice from your renewal screen?
Yes, and they confirmed my time-off bank resets in July. My analysts' review drafts are still the louder problem tonight.
Saw the Variety Playhouse post on your story. Did you grab tickets for the 27th?
Yeah, snagged two before they vanished. Their feed is dangerous, I swear half my budget leaks through it.
Same. Between you and the Fox's account my saved folder is out of control.
If you can pull Friday night, the Alliance has the new staging running. I'll send the link.
You still doing that Saturday woods thing or saving your legs for Lauren's bib chaos?
Both, somehow. Short trail Saturday, then flat practice next week.
Please do not recreate last year's urgent care field trip.
I packed the wrap and I am stopping before anything gets dramatic.
Braves tickets dropped for the 28th. You in, or is that bill spreadsheet weekend again?
I can do the game if I finish the March sheet Friday: lender, HOA, power, insurance, loan, gas, food, savings.
That list is rude. Want me to cover parking this time?
Parking would help, thanks. The regular stuff still has to clear from my account first.
Are you doing the park loop tomorrow or saving your legs for Daniel's thing?
Short loop only. Parents are coming Sunday and I promised bread plus something spicy.
Smart. Bring a slice if it survives your family.
I will. Priya wants notes too because Friday's batch disappeared fast.
For the curry night, should I bring my big pot or are your burners free?
Bring the pot, please. My stove is free, but that pot saves me from juggling batches.
Also, do you want us to leave the leftovers in your fridge or take containers back?
Take most back. I only have room for two lunches once the serving bowls go in.
For dinner tonight, do you want me to bring the lemon tart or that spicy chickpea thing?
Lemon tart, please. I am bringing salad and fizzy water. The red from last month is still unopened here, so you and Daniel can claim it.
Ha, very on brand. Also Daniel said his neighbor may bring those little party gummies again, so I will steer the table away from them.
Thank you. I have a long run tomorrow and only want dessert, water, and maybe one Advil if my head starts up from budget spreadsheets.
All these years later 💕 Your dad was on a sales call up in Athens when I went into labor at Northside. Grandma drove down from Macon by lunchtime. I still remember the song on the radio.
If you come by after the market, could you bring the peaches you found last time? Your father liked them.
Yes. I am also doing a Costco run, so I can bring the big yogurt box and berries for tomorrow.
ily mom ❤️ dinner at 6:30 - you and Dad bringing the cake?
Yes - German chocolate, your grandma's recipe from her Macon church cookbook. Wear something other than the work navy please.
Thank you. Do not carry too much at once, especially with all your pots on the patio needing attention.
no promises 😂 see you at 6
I only need to tie up the tomato stems and pinch the basil. The rest can wait.
I found the black bean bake recipe. Would that work for your parents' place tomorrow?
Perfect. I'm stopping there early to look at a bill with Mom, then Daniel said he'll put the game on.
I'll bring it in a dish that can go straight in the oven. Do you want me to print the recipe for Elena too?
Yes please. She keeps asking for the one you made last time.
saturday cooking thing - my place or that new spot in old fourth ward? eastside trail walkable from beltline.
old fourth ward please. i can park at ponce city market and just walk. anything that doesn't put me back on 85 northbound at 7pm.
ha noted. you really need to move inside the perimeter someday
if gwinnett ever finishes the heavy rail study i'd stay put. otherwise yeah, i look at decatur listings every other month.
That Kyoto cafe account posted the canal trees again. I am sending it before I lose the link.
Do not tempt me. I put the screenshot in the April-blooms folder and closed the airfare tab.
Fair. We can make matcha shortbread at the cooking meetup and pretend that counts for now.
Perfect. Cheaper than two weeks across the ocean and still very useful for morale.
mom forwarded me that refi mailer again. she keeps asking if you should do it
i ran the math. closing costs eat the savings unless i'm staying past year 5. and i'd rather just keep chipping the Nelnet piece down
how much is left on that thing honestly
under 18k. one line item, no cards, nothing owed to anyone in the family. i sleep fine
Maya's cousin is pushing me hard on a pre-revenue clean energy thing. 40k minimum. Says it'll 10x.
Mom said you were up past midnight again. Doing what.
How are they measuring impact, or is it just 'green' on the deck?
Rewriting a Power BI model for the FP&A team. The DAX I wrote three years ago is embarrassing, I keep wanting to fix it.
Lol mostly the deck.
Nobody's making you do that at 1am.
I know. Same reason I stayed on the transformation team instead of taking the close-the-books role at Apex. I'd rather build the thing than just run it.

Then it's a lottery ticket, not an investment. Keep the six months of expenses untouched, anything past that goes into the boring stuff that compounds. I'm not putting concentrated money into something I can't read a real report on.
Saw a Theory blazer on sale at the Avalon outlet, navy, $189 down from 425. Your color.
Tempting but I'm holding the apparel bucket for September. Need two new pairs of trousers and a structured jacket before the budget cycle restarts at work.
That far out? It'll be gone by Friday lol
I know. The cooler-weather refresh always knocks me 4-500 over my normal month, so I'd rather load the sinking fund now than improvise in October.
Did you ever finish the Hannah-Jones book? I'm on chapter 9 and it's wrecking me in a good way.
Almost. I've been pairing it with that Code Switch episode about co-responder programs in other cities. Slow read though, work has been brutal.
Same. By the way — I dropped $40 to that bail-fund coalition you mentioned at brunch. Small but felt right.
I do a recurring $25 to a similar one. It's not much but it's steady. Want to do the cooking meetup Saturday and actually talk about the book?
you alive? saw your light on at like midnight when I dropped off mom's chair
ugh. rebuilding the validation tabs for the consolidated workbook. one tab flagged 14 mismatches between the GL pull and the deck last close and nobody noticed until the readout
lol so the slides lied
the slides parroted whatever the model spit out. now there's a second-review checklist too. Renu signed off on it Friday.
Decatur coffee Friday still works? I can send the ginger-tulsi blend too if you liked it.
Friday works. I used the last packet after my 4:30 call and it helped me settle before cooking.
I’ll bring more. Want me to hold your phone during our square walk again?
Yes please. If it is in my bag I will check it, so let’s make it impossible.
Curry Thursday or Friday? I can do either but Thursday is tight after the client thing.
Friday is safer. Thursday I am running the risk review with Karthik's team and the finance transformation steerco bleeds into the evening.
Steerco still on the Workday rollout? That has been your whole quarter.
Pretty much. Same building, same fluorescent lights for five years now. Friday 7?
Dad's reading another warehouse memoir. He keeps texting me lines about shift dispatch and forklift routing like I asked.
He spent thirty years moving pallets and supervising shift crews, of course he has thoughts.
He told me again about the night-shift roster spreadsheet that 'kept the whole DC running.' Mom rolled her eyes from across the room, I could feel it through the phone.
Two years into retirement and the man still talks like he's auditing dock 4. Let him have it.
Mija the Gwinnett International Night flyer came home with the library books. They're doing it the Saturday after Easter at Bethesda Park
Oh wow, is that still the same one? I remember singing at it in middle school, the year they had the Vietnamese lion dancers
Same one. Your dad wants pupusas this time and Daniel said he'll come if there's birria
Put me down. I'll drive up from Lilburn after my Saturday run
ok so the form for Daniel's new HR thing wants me to put his ethnicity. He said 'just check whatever you check' lol
Ha. I do White and Hispanic on those. Dad's side. Daniel does the same I'm pretty sure.
Got it, two boxes then. Thanks. Also — recipe for the green sauce at Abuela's lunch?? everyone asked me
lol I'd have to ask Tia Rosa. She rattled it off in Spanish last time and I caught maybe half. I'll text her this week.
Random — Daniel asked me what to put for your bio in the family Easter slideshow lol. He said 'something finance.'
Ha. Just copy my headline: 'Senior Financial Analyst, Atlanta. UGA Terry '13, Goizueta MBA '17.'
Stealing it verbatim. Did you really do both back to back? I always forget.
Worked two years between them. Best decision — went back when I knew what I actually wanted out of grad school.
Can we move dumplings to 7:15 on Thursday? Client call got wedged into the sane dinner hour.
7:15 is fine. I may come straight from CVS because Dr. Nguyen's office posted the after-visit note.
Got it. Do you want something light for dinner if you're doing errands first?
Yes, please. I also want to finish the JAMA explainer she linked before I decide which appointment slot to take.
Mija, did you see Tia Rosa's 60th invite on the family page? She added the address last night.
I saw the original post but not the update, let me check. Is it still the 11th?
Yes 11th. Also the Lilburn Parkview alumni group reposted that school board candidate meet-and-greet, I thought you'd want it before you vote.
Forwarded the invite to Daniel and Maya. And yes, I'll look at the meet-and-greet, I like to read up before I go in.
Are you still going to the candidate forum tomorrow night? Daniel said you two are riding together.
Yeah, 7pm at the rec center. I want to hear what they say about the media center budget and how they're handling the rezoning lines.
Good. Are you eating, mija? Budget weeks I worry about you sleeping past the laptop.
I ate. Bowl from the place on Ponce. Lights out by 11, promise. Lunch Sunday still on — I'll bring the ACA comparison printout for Dad.
I skimmed your one-page plan. The Gwinnett pilot reads stronger if you separate the Saturday classes from the 501(c)(3) timeline.
That makes sense. I keep mixing the April workshops with the bigger structure I want for women and recent grads.
Use two tracks: current sessions with topics and attendance, then the later entity, board, and funding pieces.
I can revise after my next prepared speech. The five-minute version needs to sound less like a grant memo.
I can move dumplings to Sunday if tonight is still a numbers night. No heroic midweek cooking required.
Thank you. I need one more hour for the reforecast file, then I am shutting the inbox before 9 and doing nothing with a screen.
Good. Tea, shower, lights low. You mentioned the tight-chest thing last time this cycle got messy.
Exactly why I am stopping on time tonight. Last week landed at 49.5 and this one is trying to creep higher.
did you ever submit the Northwestern Mutual quote?
yeah finally. got it in Friday before the rate band cutoff - they re-band you on your birthday
ow. final rate?
$34/mo for 20-year. the supplement asked about prior or current uniformed service in two different sections - just clicked no all the way down. so much paperwork
Kyoto pricing update: shoulder-season flights from ATL are sitting around $1,650 right now. Hotel runs ~$220/night for the ryokan area.
Doable. The travel sub-account auto-fills $200 every payday, so by April it'll be close to 2k. I'll pull the flight off that and let the hotel build until fall.
Smart. You're not splitting it with anyone right? Just yours to plan around.
All mine. Only one paycheck feeding it, so I have to be patient. Friday's hits and another $200 lands.
Mom said dad's cardiologist copay jumped to $75 and the EOB has three line items she can't make sense of.
She called me at lunch. I told her I'd cover this one straight from my account and we can untangle the billing at Sunday lunch. Bring your laptop.
Appreciate you. Also Braves home opener tix dropped today - want me to grab two for the April 3 game? $88 each in the 200 level.
Grab them. I'll Venmo you the $176 tonight after my run.
Saturday 5K link is live. You want me to put you on our team, or are you saving the morning for yourself?
Put me down. I blocked the morning, and nobody at home needs me back by a certain time.
Nice. Post-run coffee then? I can introduce you to Sam from the Thursday group if he shows.
Coffee yes. Sam intro is fine, but I am mostly there for the run and a quiet afternoon.
That biscuit reel you liked is dangerous. Want to try the Candler Park counter Sunday?
Yes. I saved their menu post and the blue storefront so I can recognize it.
Cute. Also Daniel said you sent him a tiny jazz room near Edgewood from someone’s story?
It popped up after the biscuit place. I put it with the ATL night-out saves.
Did you make it home okay? Daniel said the meeting ran long.
Home, doors locked, car checked. Did the walk-around twice because I left my laptop bag in the passenger seat by accident earlier.
Twice is good. I worry about your block since the February thefts. Officer Ramirez at the HOA coffee seemed nice though, he gave us a phone tree number.
He was. I saved it. Honestly the only time I talk to any of them is that and the two stops I've ever had, both for stupid little things.
Braves tickets for the 28th are cheap. You up for upper deck stairs or should I grab lower?
Upper deck is fine. Ankle behaved on the BeltLine, and my check-in Thursday was the usual quick in-and-out.
Good. Tailgate plan is still burgers? I can bring a cooler.
Burgers work. I will bring seltzers and take one of whatever you bring if it is after first pitch.
Braves game got moved earlier. Want us to swing by after and eat at your place instead of fighting Decatur parking?
Yes, come by around 7:15. I can do tacos and the patio if the rain holds.
Need anything besides tortillas?
Ice and limes. I will leave the porch light on if I am still wiping down the table.
Signed us up for the FWHC 5K on April 18th, same wave as last year. $45 entry, donation tier on top.
In. Bumped the donation tier to $75 this time. How's the hamstring?
Fine. Yours? Ankle still tight after the Sweetwater trail?
Tight but ok with the new stretches. I'm also doing the climate resilience run with Priya in May. Pacing it slow — Saturday morning is the one thing budget season doesn't get to take from me.
